rules.name: bridge-offline
rules.description: a bridge lost its connection to the broker or crashed (mqtt-gateway publishes <topic>/bridge/state)
rules.title: {device} bridge is offline

rules.name: zigbee2mqtt-offline
rules.description: zigbee2mqtt publishes its bridge state as JSON, so the plain rule above does not match it
rules.title: zigbee2mqtt is offline

rules.name: device-unavailable
rules.description: the bridge runs, but cannot reach the device behind it
rules.title: {device} is unreachable

rules.name: shelly-unreachable
rules.description: a Shelly dropped off the network (Gen1 publishes shellies/<id>/online, Gen2+ <prefix>/online)
rules.title: Shelly {device} is unreachable

rules.name: reconnect-loop
rules.description: looks alive but keeps reconnecting or restarting; needs a bridge that mirrors its log to <topic>/bridge/logs
rules.title: {device} is stuck in a reconnect loop

rules.name: data-silent
rules.description: a service that normally publishes all the time went quiet; list one filter per service and measure its longest normal gap first
rules.title: {device} stopped publishing

rules.name: battery-low
rules.description: a Zigbee sensor battery needs replacing
rules.title: {device}: battery at {value} %

rules.name: nuki-battery-critical
rules.description: a door lock is about to run out of battery (Nuki Hub)
rules.title: Nuki {device}: battery critical

rules.name: roborock-error
rules.description: a vacuum is stuck or needs attention (roborock-mqtt)
rules.title: Roborock {device} reports error {value}

rules.name: node-disk-full
rules.description: a filesystem of the server is nearly full
rules.title: Disk {mountpoint} is {value} % full

rules.name: node-disk-filling
rules.description: at the rate of the last 6 hours the disk runs full within 4 days
rules.title: Disk {mountpoint} will be full within 4 days

rules.name: node-memory
rules.description: the server is running out of memory; the kernel starts killing pods next
rules.title: Server memory at {value} %

rules.name: node-temperature
rules.description: CPU temperature; the threshold suits a Raspberry Pi, which throttles from about 80 °C
rules.title: CPU at {value} °C

rules.name: node-load
rules.description: sustained load above 2 per core
rules.title: Load is {value} per core

rules.name: pod-restarting
rules.description: a container keeps crashing
rules.title: {namespace}/{pod} restarted {value} times within an hour

rules.name: pod-oom-killed
rules.description: a container was killed for exceeding its memory limit
rules.title: {namespace}/{pod} was OOM-killed
rules.query: max by (namespace, pod) (kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"} == 1 and on(namespace, pod, container) increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[1h]) > 0)

rules.name: pod-not-running
rules.description: a pod cannot start (image pull, scheduling, missing volume)
rules.title: {namespace}/{pod} is stuck in {phase}

rules.name: deployment-unavailable
rules.description: a deployment has fewer ready pods than it should
rules.title: {namespace}/{deployment} is not fully available

rules.name: job-failed
rules.description: a Kubernetes job failed; a CronJob whose image disappeared fails like this every run, silently
rules.title: Job {namespace}/{job_name} failed

rules.name: certificate-expiring
rules.description: needs cert-manager metrics; it renews 30 days ahead, so under 14 days means renewal is failing
rules.title: Certificate {name} expires in {value} days

rules.name: scrape-target-down
rules.description: Prometheus cannot collect from a target, so the rules above are blind for it
rules.title: Metrics target {job} ({instance}) is down
